Overview
Stronger defense, faster response, and resilient recovery
Cyber threats, data exposure, and technology risk are escalating in frequency, scale, and impact. What were once isolated incidents can now disrupt operations, compromise sensitive data, and erode trust across the enterprise, often as organizations accelerate digital transformation and expand cloud and data environments.
We help organizations protect against cyber attacks, secure critical data, and manage technology risk in a way that help keep pace with the business. From strengthening defenses and improving threat detection to enabling faster, more coordinated response and recovery, we support leaders facing complex cyber and technology risk.
Experience makes the difference when stakes are high. We bring deep cyber knowledge and firsthand experience supporting organizations through their most complex security and controls challenges, giving leaders the confidence to act decisively and protect trust when it matters most.

Technology risk: So pervasive, it’s hard to see
Technology risk is a term describing the many vulnerabilities associated with an organization’s information technology (IT), operational technology (OT) and communications technology (CT). A central problem of such risks is that they are so all-encompassing they go unnoticed. Hiding in plain sight, their sheer scale, paradoxically, obscures their sheer scale. Instead, we get glimpses here and there but rarely connect the dots across the enterprise. 

 

We believe assessing, managing and reducing technology risk requires an enterprise-wide level of coordination. Only by looking horizontally across organizational silos will the scope and severity of the threat become clear. This means tech, risk and other business leaders should collaborate across the silos to understand the risk and its many permutations, identify what’s affected and size the gaps.
